verses.text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
lines: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed.
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

verses.text: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
lines: For you have been a refuge for me,
a strong tower from the enemy.

verses.text: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.
lines: I will dwell in your tent forever.
I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings.

verses.text: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
lines: For you, God, have heard my vows.
You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

verses.text: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.
lines: You will prolong the king’s life.
His years will be for generations.

verses.text: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
lines: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever.
Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

verses.text: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
lines: So I will sing praise to your name forever,
that I may fulfill my vows daily.
